scope: Complete direct three-center projective resolution, locally trivial third-projection bundle and exact smooth-base pluriharmonic pairing.
mathematical_boundary: The independent pairing lemma is checked at its stated range. The original exceptional restriction, analytic cut-off and residual-center identification remain pending; no full transform/Siu adoption or original closure.

direct_obligations.name: Range
direct_obligations.check: k≥3,1≤p≤k−2 guarantees all exponents positive and less than center codimension k.

direct_obligations.name: Centers
direct_obligations.check: Three projective(k−1)-planes are pairwise disjoint since each simultaneous linear relation forces the zero vector.

direct_obligations.name: Smooth model
direct_obligations.check: Blow-ups of disjoint smooth centers are smooth projective and commute.

direct_obligations.name: Graph
direct_obligations.check: Fiber[u:w] with w in the base line maps to[u:u+w], resolving exactly the rational[v−u] projection.

direct_obligations.name: Incidence
direct_obligations.check: Local equations are the ordinary blow-up of k transverse coordinates at C.

direct_obligations.name: Projectivization convention
direct_obligations.check: The model uses lines in O^k plus O(−1), with no dual convention change.

direct_obligations.name: First section
direct_obligations.check: A becomes[0:w], disjoint from the exceptional C divisor.

direct_obligations.name: Second section
direct_obligations.check: B becomes[−w:w] and is disjoint from the first section.

direct_obligations.name: Local frame
direct_obligations.check: A holomorphic frame sending a generator to e1 fixes both points in each projective-k fiber.

direct_obligations.name: Fiber blow-up
direct_obligations.check: Local products with two fixed disjoint sections give the asserted proper holomorphic fiber bundle.

direct_obligations.name: Other projections
direct_obligations.check: Their sole base centers A and B are resolved by the corresponding blow-ups.

direct_obligations.name: Dimension
direct_obligations.check: Z dimension2k−1 and base k−1 give relative dimension k.

direct_obligations.name: Smooth integration
direct_obligations.check: Compact fixed fibers allow differentiation of smooth fiber integrals; type(k+p) decreases to p.

direct_obligations.name: Closedness
direct_obligations.check: Proper fiber integration commutes with exterior differentiation.

direct_obligations.name: Strong positivity
direct_obligations.check: Wedges of semipositive(1,1)-forms are strongly positive and submersion fiber integration preserves that cone.

direct_obligations.name: Projection classes
direct_obligations.check: Linear systems vanishing once along their respective centers give H−D_A,H−D_B,H−D_C.

direct_obligations.name: Disjoint divisors
direct_obligations.check: Products of distinct exceptional classes vanish, using smooth representatives with disjoint support.

direct_obligations.name: Restriction of H
direct_obligations.check: On each exceptional divisor H pulls back from its projective(k−1)-dimensional center.

direct_obligations.name: Pure exceptional terms
direct_obligations.check: For1≤j≤k−1, H^(2k−1−j) restricts to zero because its exponent is at least k.

direct_obligations.name: Top degree
direct_obligations.check: The total exponent(p+1)+(k−1)+(k−p−1) is2k−1.

direct_obligations.name: Birational normalization
direct_obligations.check: Integral of H^(2k−1) is one by degree-one change of variables.

direct_obligations.name: Class determination
direct_obligations.check: H^(2p) of projective(k−1)-space is one-dimensional with normalized generator sigma^p.

direct_obligations.name: Smooth primitive
direct_obligations.check: The retained smooth Kahler ddc lemma provides a smooth real(p−1,p−1)-form, never an L1 primitive.

direct_obligations.name: Legal current pairing
direct_obligations.check: Smooth primitive can be tested against arbitrary distributional ddcS=0.

direct_obligations.name: Submersion pullback
direct_obligations.check: Pullback of base currents under the proper submersion is defined and satisfies the fiber-integration adjunction.

direct_obligations.name: Degree of product
direct_obligations.check: Pullback S degree k−p−1 plus k+p gives top degree2k−1 on Z.

direct_obligations.name: Excluded endpoint
direct_obligations.check: p=k−1 makes theta_u^k vanish identically; no endpoint mass-one assertion.

direct_obligations.name: External bridge
direct_obligations.check: No identification or cut-off of the original exceptional mass current is inferred.

direct_obligations.name: Exact source locator
direct_obligations.check: Raw Latin1 and UTF8 source line304 contains cohomology paragraph;306 contains harmonic example.

direct_obligations.name: Preserved scope
direct_obligations.check: No book theorem, original problem closure, full transform/Siu adoption or movable-density certification.
